record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> The LORD<WH03068> hear<WH06030><WTH8799> thee in the day<WH03117> of trouble<WH06869>; the name<WH08034> of the God<WH0430> of Jacob<WH03290> defend<WH07682><WTH8762> thee; <RF>defend...: Heb. set thee on an high place<Rf>
